description: Compact projection of frozen P0d evidence. All 48 raw measurement observations and status/schedule/semantic ledgers are retained. Repeated decoded outputs, fixture text, and full dependency-closure path lists are omitted; numeric metrics, identity fields, input/output digests, source sizes/hashes, closure sizes/counts/digests, and execution receipts are preserved. Diagnostic artifacts were not collected for P0d.

launchEnvelope.statusContext: Creation-time status of this immutable envelope artifact, before independent review. The final prelaunch manifest binds this exact file SHA to an APPROVED review before the separate launch.
launchEnvelope.reason: Prevent an external process kill from preempting the CLI's unchanged work deadline and report finalization.
launchEnvelope.scope: Only an external guard. Prepared pnpm executable/argv, operation counts, inputs, selected phases, CLI budgets and methods remain unchanged.
launchEnvelope.reporting: Record complete process elapsed wall time separately from report.elapsedMs; disclose the70s external guard and60s/49s CLI budgets. An externally killed process with no ledger remains execution-unknown and unscored; no outcome-driven retry.
